newsitem.title: USA: Intensiva sees increased Q2 net loss.
newsitem.headline: Intensiva sees increased Q2 net loss.

text.p: Intensiva HealthCare Corp said Friday it expects to incur an increased net loss in the second quarter versus the first quarter because the company will open three to four hospitals.
The acute-care hospital operations concern reported a first-quarter loss of $85,000 on sales of $12.4 million, versus a year-ago loss of $730,000 on sales of $2.5 million.
"We are pleased with the substantial revenue growth in the first quarter," said chief executive David Cross.
"We are increasingly confident that we will achieve our goal of reaching profitability in 1997," he said.
Intensiva reported a 1996 net loss of $5 million.
He said the company plans to open 11 hospitals in 1997, which will increase its network to 21 hospitals.
